title: Revenue share of total
prompt: Return product, revenue, and pct_of_total — each product's revenue expressed as a percentage (0-100) of the total revenue across all products, rounded to 2 decimal places. Compute the total using a window SUM() OVER () with no PARTITION BY.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE product_revenue (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, product TEXT, revenue REAL); INSERT INTO product_revenue VALUES (1,'Widget',1000.0),(2,'Gadget',2500.0),(3,'Gizmo',1500.0),(4,'Doohickey',3000.0),(5,'Thingamajig',2000.0);
reference_sql: SELECT product, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS pct_of_total FROM product_revenue;
